title: Close out Phase 4: retro, then flesh out Phase 5 into ticks
description:
Run the epic-close retro, then plan the next feasible epic into child ticks.

The next in soft order is yvi (Phase 5: the Cloudflare Computer executor), with djo (Phase 4b: subscription seats as flat-rate credentials) also unblocked by this phase - pick by feasibility, not by number, and say which and why.

The retro must answer the question Phase 3's could not: can ticfac run an epic unattended? Phase 3 said no and named 9da as the blocker. If this phase's gate was met, say what changed; if it was met only with help, say exactly where the help was needed. A retro that records a pass the run did not earn is worse than no retro.
